title: Queenstown · Crown Range and Milford Approach
slogan: Alpine lake roads and a weather-aware overnight plan.
story: Alpine lake roads and a weather-aware overnight plan. Out of Arrowtown and back again: 356 km, roughly 6 h 51 in the saddle. It goes by way of Wanaka lake stop, Milford Road high section and Te Anau overnight. Crown Range Road is the high point. It tops out at about 1,150 m. The passes are the reason to go.
